canonicalProposition: The Viksit Bharat – Guarantee for Rozgar and Ajeevika Mission (Gramin) Act, 2025 (Act No. 18 of 2025) expanded the statutory rural wage employment guarantee to 125 days per household starting 1 July 2026.
MGNREGA 2005 (Act No. 42 of 2005) stood repealed under Section 36(1) of Act No. 18 of 2025 effective July 1, 2026 with full transitional job card protection.
Under the historical MGNREGA 2005 framework, 100 days of wage employment were guaranteed per rural household per financial year.
Active registered rural workers under India's employment guarantee program totaled 14.2 crore in FY2025-26.
Women participation in rural employment guarantee schemes reached 55.3% in FY2025-26.
The Reserve Bank of India policy repo rate stands at 5.25% as of July 2026 following a 125 bps cumulative rate easing cycle.
The RBI MPC maintained a peak pause rate of 6.50% from February 2023 through December 2024 before initiating rate cuts.
The Standing Deposit Facility (SDF) rate is set at 5.00% as of July 2026.
The Marginal Standing Facility (MSF) rate is set at 5.50% as of July 2026.
In the June 2024 Lok Sabha general elections, the BJP secured 240 seats and the NDA coalition secured 293 seats, forming a coalition government.
The pre-election campaign target declared by BJP leadership was 370 seats for BJP and 400+ seats for the NDA coalition.
Article 368 of the Constitution of India requires 362 votes in the 543-member Lok Sabha to pass constitutional amendments needing a two-thirds majority.
With 293 NDA seats, the ruling coalition faces a 69-seat shortfall for two-thirds constitutional amendments without multi-party consensus.
The CGWB 2025 National Compilation records total annual groundwater recharge of 449.12 BCM and total extraction of 240.15 BCM, yielding a national extraction stage of 58.59%.
Total extractable groundwater resource in India stands at 409.85 BCM under the CGWB 2025 assessment.
Nationwide, 1,118 of 6,738 assessment units (16.59%) are categorized as over-exploited by CGWB in 2025.
Agricultural irrigation accounts for 89% of total annual groundwater extraction in India.
Government fiscal incentive outlay for the India Semiconductor Mission is set at ₹76,000 crore ($10 billion).
Approved private project investment commitments total ₹1.26 lakh crore ($15.2 billion) across 5 semiconductor facilities.
Commercial semiconductor packaging commenced in India in Q1 2026 at the CG Semi OSAT facility in Sanand, Gujarat.
The Micron ATMP facility in Sanand reached PILOT_PRODUCTION status with commercial packaging volume ramp-up in H1 2026.
